Hello,
Your trust and positive feedback towards our team mean a great deal to us.

We are delighted that our care was beneficial for your pet.

We remain available to provide you with convenient service and answer any questions you may have.

Your veterinary team

Hello,

Your Veterinary Team
The team was very attentive and responsive! They did everything to ensure the animal wasn't stressed, and everything went smoothly.
A patient, understanding, and welcoming approach, all for the best for the animal, thank you.
Thank you for the care given to my cat; I'm so glad this clinic is nearby! The team is friendly and professional.

We received a warm welcome (my daughter, my cat, and myself ;)) from the moment we arrived and right up until we got to the clinic! The team was lovely, helpful, and competent; we're so glad we chose this clinic for Minouchette.
Best vet ever, super gentle and prevented serious complications for my cat - without exorbitant fees! Thank you so much 🙏
Great team, very professional and welcoming! A big thank you from Lemon and Arthur

Hello, I wanted to thank Dr. Vey and his veterinary assistant for their warm welcome and excellent care!

We were seen quickly for our 16-year-old cat, Lilou, who was experiencing anorexia and nausea. After a reassuring clinical examination and an injection of anti-nausea medication, Lilou regained her appetite!
Thank you again for everything, and since we were on vacation in Marseille, we were able to return to Bordeaux without any worries.

Maryline and Patrick

My Persian cat has been seen by Dr. Vey for a few years now, and I'm very happy with her.

She gives excellent advice, takes the time to answer questions and address concerns, and is very attentive to animals, as is her assistant, who is always very friendly and smiling.

I came in for a simple booster vaccination for my cat. The appointment could have been over in 5 minutes, but Dr. Vey took her time, answered all my questions, and was lovely and patient with my cat. You can tell there's a real love for animals, and that's wonderful! Thank you!

I'm really happy with this veterinary clinic I just discovered.
The staff are friendly, very gentle with your pet, and very professional. I highly recommend them.
First experience with my two cats and absolutely fantastic! Kind, patient, excellent care for the animals, and above all, a successful service.

We met with Dr. Vey and her assistant for our 9-month-old Siberian kitten.

The welcome and professionalism were excellent. Dr. Vey is very conscientious and attentive.

Love for animals is part of the clinic's philosophy; it's not a factory, but simply a place where parents are cared for and reassured.

The treatment worked very well.
Our kitten recovered very quickly.

We highly recommend the Argos Marseille Breteuil clinic and Dr. Vey.

Josiane and Georges

A lovely team, available, attentive and patient with a scared dad (me) for his little cat (Nérou).

Following my vet's retirement, I was referred to this clinic and I'm delighted.
The staff and the vet are lovely, and most importantly, Maki is doing great!
They don't push unnecessary treatments and they check on our pets!
I highly recommend them.

I made an appointment to have my male cat neutered. I booked online and spoke to them on the phone the day before the appointment. Each time, the team was very attentive, demonstrating great adaptability, efficiency, and gentleness with my cat (Gadjo). I recommend them 100%! Thank you so much!
Efficient, highly competent staff who are wonderful with animals. I highly recommend them.

I discovered this clinic by chance a year ago, and my two dogs have been treated by this team ever since. I am always impressed by the gentleness and care they provide, not to mention the high quality of the treatment.

I highly recommend this clinic and thank you for the attention you give to my two Chihuahuas.
Excellent contact and a very warm welcome!! My puppy goes there without any fear despite his vaccinations!
Nothing to say, really, these are people who love what they do. They're passionate, it's truly a pleasure, I absolutely recommend them.
best clinic for my cat :)
